Dars motivatsiya va maqsad bilan boshlanadi, so'ng yangi leksika tanishtiriladi, keyin mustahkamlash bosqichi keladi, nihoyat baholash va uyga topshiriq bilan yakunlanadi. Shuning uchun 2‑3‑1‑4 tartibi to'g'ri.
q:
Ingliz tili darsidagi bosqichlarni to'g'ri ketma-ketlikda joylashtiring:
1. Yangi leksikani mustahkamlash
2. Motivatsiya va maqsadni belgilash
3. Yangi leksikani tanishtirish
4. Baholash va uyga topshiriq berish

explanation: Induksiya - misollardan umumiy qoidani chiqarish. Deduksiya esa umumiy qoidadan misolga o'tish. Analogi va klassifikatsiya bu vaziyatga mos kelmaydi.
q: O'qituvchi avval bir necha misollarni ko'rsatib, so'ng 'Bu gapda vaqt o'tishi ko'rsatilgan' degan umumiy qoidani chiqaradi. Bu metod nima?
O'qituvchi darsda avval qisqa dialogni o'qib, so'ng talabalarga bu dialogni rolli o'yin shaklida ijro etishni taklif qiladi. Bu metod nima?
explanation: Dialogni rolli o'yin shaklida ijro etish talabalar faol ishtirokini talab qiladi, bu rolli o'yin metodiga to'g'ri keladi. Frontal darsda o'qituvchi gapiradi, taqdimot esa vizual materiallarga asoslanadi, mustaqil o'qish yakka ishlashni anglatadi.
Formativ baholashda o'quvchilarga darhol qaytma aloqa (b) va guruh muhokamasi orqali izoh berish (e) muhim. Ballar bilan yakuniy baholash (a, d) summativ baholashga tegishli.
q:
Quyidagi baholash vositalaridan qaysilari formativ baholashga mos keladi?
a) Tezkor yozma test, ballar bilan baholanadi
b) O'quvchilarga darhol qaytma aloqa beriladigan yozma topshiriq
d) Yakuniy imtihon, ballar asosida natija chiqadi
e) Guruhdagi muhokama, o'qituvchi izoh beradi

explanation: Qisqa test tezkor bilimni baholaydi (1‑A), portfel o‘quvchining kreativ ishini ko‘rsatadi (2‑B), ochiq savollar muammoli fikrlashni rag‘batlantiradi (3‑C).
q:
Test turlarini ularning asosiy maqsadi bilan moslashtiring:
1. Qisqa savollik test
2. Portfel baholash
3. Ochiq savollar
A. O‘quvchining tezkor bilim darajasini aniqlash
B. O‘quvchining kreativ ishini ko‘rsatish
C. Muammoli fikrlashni rivojlantirish

explanation: Avval qoidani nazariy tarzda tushuntirish (1), keyin misollarni tahlil qilish (2), so'ng mustaqil mashqlar (3) va yakunida guruh rolli o'yin (4) bilan mustahkamlash. Bu ketma-ketlik o'quvchilarni bosqichma-bosqich rivojlantiradi.
q:
Yangi grammatika (present perfect)ni o'rgatish bosqichlarini to'g'ri tartibda joylashtiring:
1. Qoidani nazariy tarzda tushuntirish
2. Talabalar bilan misollarni tahlil qilish
3. O'quvchilarga mustaqil mashq berish
4. Darsni kichik guruhda rolli o'yin bilan yakunlash

explanation: Tushunarlilik tamoyili o‘quvchilarning qabul qilish imkoniyatlari, yoshi va bilim darajasini hisobga olishni talab qiladi. Bu tamoyil buzilganda darsning samaradorligi pasayadi.
q: Darsda o‘quvchilarning yoshi, bilim darajasi va qabul qilish imkoniyatlari inobatga olinmagan bo‘lsa, qaysi pedagogik tamoyil buzilgan?
O‘qituvchi avval bir necha misollarni ko‘rsatib, keyin umumiy qoidani chiqaradi. Bu qaysi metod?
explanation: Induktiv metodda o‘qituvchi avval konkret misollarni ko‘rsatadi, so‘ngdan umumiy qoidani chiqaradi. Deduktiv metodda avval umumiy qoidani berib, keyin misollarni ko‘rsatadi.
Alohida suhbat orqali o‘qituvchi sabablari aniqlanadi, muammoni konstruktiv yechishga yordam beradi; boshqa variantlar esa salbiy ijtimoiy muhit yaratadi.
q: O‘quvchi darsda chalg‘ituvchi bo‘lsa, o‘qituvchi qanday yo‘lni tanlashi eng maqbul?
O‘qituvchi darsda muammoli vazifani berib, o‘quvchilar birga yechim topadi. Bu metod qaysi dars turiga kiradi?
explanation: Muammoli darsda o‘qituvchi muammoli vazifani berib, o‘quvchilar jamoaviy tarzda yechim izlaydi; bu metod o‘quvchilarning faol ishtirokini rag‘batlantiradi.

q: O'qituvchi sinfda talabalar e'tiborsiz bo'lganda qat'iy ovozda qoida qo'yadi va sinfni tartibga soladi. Bu qaysi pedagogik qobiliyatni ko'rsatadi?
explanation: Talabalar e'tiborsiz bo'lganda o'qituvchining qat'iy, nazoratga asoslangan harakati avtoritar pedagogik qobiliyatga misoldir. Demokratik, kreativ yoki kommunikativ qobiliyatlar bu holatda namoyon bo'lmaydi.

mnemonic: Diagnoz boshda, Formativ yo‘lda, Summativ oxirda.
explanation: Diagnostik baholash boshlang‘ich bilimni aniqlashga, formativ baholash o‘quv jarayonida darhol qayta aloqa berishga, summativ baholash esa yakuniy natijani baholashga xizmat qiladi. Shuning uchun 1‑A, 2‑B, 3‑C mosligi to‘g‘ri.
q:
Quyidagi baholash turlarini ularning maqsadi bilan moslashtiring:
1. Diagnostik
2. Formativ
3. Summativ
A. O‘quvchining boshlang‘ich bilim darajasini aniqlash
B. O‘quv jarayonida darhol qayta aloqa berish
C. Yil oxirida yakuniy natijani baholash

Quyidagi dars bosqichlarini to‘g‘ri tartibda joylashtiring:
1. Yangi materialni taqdim etish
2. Motivatsiya va kirish
3. Mustahkamlash va amaliy mashg‘ulot
4. Baholash va uyga vazifa berish
explanation: Dars avvalo motivatsiya va kirish bilan boshlanadi, keyin yangi material taqdim etiladi, undan keyin mustahkamlash (amaliy mashg‘ulot) amalga oshiriladi, oxirida baholash va uyga vazifa beriladi. Shuning uchun 2‑1‑3‑4 tartibi to‘g‘ri.

Guruhlarga rollar berib muhokama qilish rol‑o‘ynash metodining asosiy xususiyatidir. Frontal so‘rovda bitta savolga butun sinf javob beradi, taqdimot o‘qituvchi tomonidan amalga oshiriladi, mustaqil ishlash yakka tartibda bo‘ladi.
q: O‘qituvchi sinfni 4‑ta kichik guruhga bo‘lib, har bir guruhga turli rollar berib, muhokama olib boradi. Bu qaysi metod?
O‘qituvchi sinfda tartibsizlik ko‘rinsa, darhol qo‘llab-quvvatlaydigan va qat'iy qoidalarga murojaat qiluvchi usulni qaysi deb ataladi?
explanation: Avtoritar boshqaruvda o‘qituvchi qat'iy qoidalar va darhol choralar bilan sinfni nazorat qiladi. Demokratik boshqaruvda qarorlar o‘quvchilar bilan birga qabul qilinadi, liberal va konsensus usullar esa yanada yumshoq yondashuvni talab qiladi.

q: O‘qituvchi dars davomida o‘quvchilarga qisqa yozma topshiriqlar berib, ularning javoblarini darhol tahlil qilib, qayta aloqa beradi. Bu qaysi baholash turi?
explanation: Formativ baholash dars jarayonida o‘quvchilarning o‘zlashtirishini kuzatadi va darhol qayta aloqa beradi. Summativ va diagnostik baholashlar yakuniy yoki boshlang‘ich bosqichda qo‘llaniladi.

Rubrika maqsadi o‘quvchi ishini tizimli tahlil qilish (A), test savollari aniq bilimlarni tez baholash (B), portfoliyo o‘quvchining rivojlanish jarayonini ko‘rsatadi (C). Shuning uchun 1‑A, 2‑B, 3‑C mosligi to‘g‘ri.
q:
Quyidagi baholash vositalarini ularning funksiyasi bilan moslashtiring:
1. Rubrika
2. Test savollari
3. Portfoliyo
A. O‘quvchi ishini tizimli tahlil qilish
B. Aniq bilimlarni tez baholash
C. O‘quvchining rivojlanish jarayonini ko‘rsatish

explanation: Qisqa nazorat ishini bajarish va natijalar darsni takomillashtirishga yo'naltirilgan bo'lsa, bu formativ baholash hisoblanadi. Summativ yakuniy baholashga, diagnostik boshlang'ich darajani aniqlashga, talim baholash esa umumiy atama.
q: O'qituvchi dars oxirida 5 savollik nazorat ishini o'tkazdi, lekin baholash natijasi dars rejasini o'zgartirish uchun ishlatiladi. Bu baholash turi?

explanation: The passage links Maya’s flawless performance with the audience’s applause, indicating that the applause was a response to her skill. The other options introduce unrelated motives.
opts: A) They were impressed by Maya’s flawless performance.
B) They disliked the piece but felt polite.
C) They wanted Maya to play again immediately.
D) They were waiting for the next performer.
q:
Read the passage:
"After weeks of practicing, Maya finally performed her piano piece without a single mistake. The audience erupted into applause, and she beamed with pride." Which statement best explains why the audience applauded?

explanation: Jamoaviy rolli o‘yinlar (a) va ovozli qayta eshitish (d) o‘quvchilarga nutqni amalda qo‘llash va o‘zlashtirish imkonini beradi. Individual yozma topshiriqlar (b) ham foydali, lekin mustaqil nutqga to‘g‘ridan‑to‘g‘ri aloqada emas; avtomatik tarjima (e) esa ko‘nikma rivojlanishiga kamaytiruvchi vositadir.
q:
Quyidagi usullarni o‘quvchilarga mustaqil nutq ko‘nikmasini rivojlantirishda qo‘llashga mos kelishini belgilang.
a) Jamoaviy rolli o‘yinlar
b) Individual yozma topshiriqlar
d) Ovozli qayta eshitish
e) Qurilma bilan avtomatik tarjima
O'qituvchi dars boshlanishida qisqa test o'tkazib, o'quvchilarning oldingi mavzu bo'yicha bilimini aniqladi, bu qaysi baholash turi?
explanation: Test dars boshlanishida o'tkazilib, o'quvchilarning avvalgi bilim darajasini aniqlashga qaratilganligi sababli diagnostik baholashga kiradi. Formativ baholash davomiy jarayonda, summativ yakuniy natijada, kollektiv esa guruhga nisbatan.

q: In a meeting about budget allocation, a participant says, "By the way, my cat just learned a new trick." This utterance is:
opts: B) A summary of the previous point.
explanation: The statement does not relate to the budget discussion and therefore is off‑topic. It is neither a request nor a summary.

opts: A) Thanks for sharing, but let's return to the main argument about climate policy.
B) That was interesting! By the way, did anyone finish the assignment?
C) I think we should change the subject to something fun.
D) Wow, I love stories. Tell me more about your childhood.
q: In a group discussion, after someone finishes a long anecdote, which response best keeps the conversation on topic?
explanation: Option C acknowledges the contribution while steering the discussion back to the original topic, maintaining relevance. The other options either shift focus elsewhere or ignore the agenda.

q: Read the text: "The museum opened its new wing last month. Visitors praised the modern architecture, which contrasts sharply with the historic building nearby." Which element primarily contributes to the text's coherence?
explanation: The contrast between modern architecture and the historic building provides a logical connection that holds the passage together, ensuring coherence. "Which" creates a cohesive tie, but the contrast drives the overall meaning.
opts: A) The repetition of the noun "building"
B) The use of the word "which" as a relative pronoun
C) The contrast between modern and historic styles
D) The chronological order of events

explanation: The statement about reduced stress levels is the concrete evidence that ties gardening to mental health. The other sentences describe trends or facts unrelated to the specific claim.
opts: B) Studies indicate lower stress levels for gardeners.
C) Urban gardening is becoming more popular.
D) Cities have limited green space.
q: Passage: "The rise of urban gardening has been linked to improved mental health, as studies indicate that people who tend to plants report lower stress levels and higher satisfaction." Which detail directly supports the claim about mental health?

Read the passage:
"After weeks of rehearsals, Jenna stepped onto the stage, took a deep breath, and whispered, 'Here we go again.'"What does Jenna most likely feel?
explanation: The phrase 'Here we go again' suggests a repeated, perhaps stressful experience, indicating anxiety. The other choices do not match the implied tone.
opts: B) Anxiety because of past difficulties.
D) Excitement about a new opportunity.

q: Dars boshlanishida o‘qituvchi qisqa video klip ko‘rsatib, mavzuga oid qiziqarli faktni aytadi. Bu qaysi motivatsiya usuli?
explanation: Kontekstual motivatsiya o‘quvchini mavzu bilan aloqador, qiziqarli ma’lumotlar orqali qiziqtiradi. Materialistik motivatsiya materialga e’tibor, eksternal motivatsiya tashqi rag‘bat, sanksionli motivatsiya jazolar bilan bog‘liq.
Diagnostik baholash dars yoki kurs oldidan o‘quvchilarning boshlang‘ich darajasini aniqlashga yo‘naltirilgan. Formativ baholash davomida, summativ esa yakuniy natijalar uchun ishlatiladi.
q: O‘qituvchi dars boshlanishida o‘quvchilarning mavzu bo‘yicha avvalgi bilim darajasini aniqlash uchun qisqa test o'tkazadi. Bu baholash turi qaysi?

explanation: Dars avvalo motivatsiya va kirish bilan boshlanadi, keyin yangi materialni tushuntirish, amaliy mashg‘ulot, oxirida xulosa va baholash amalga oshiriladi.
q:
Quyidagi dars bosqichlarini to‘g‘ri ketma‑ketlikda joylashtiring:
1. Yangi materialni tushuntirish
2. Motivatsiya va kirish
3. Amaliy mashg‘ulot
4. Xulosa va baholash

explanation: Pedagogik takt o‘qituvchining tinchlantiruvchi ovoz (a) va muammoli vaziyatda muloyim yondashuvi (d) ni o‘z ichiga oladi. Jazo (b) va mustaqil xato aniqlash (e) bu konseptga to‘g‘ri kelmaydi.
q:
Quyidagi mulohazalardan pedagogik taktga oid to‘g‘ri bo‘lishlarini aniqlang.
a) O‘qituvchi tinchlantiruvchi ovoz bilan gapiradi
b) O‘quvchilarga jazaviy choralar qo‘llanadi
d) Muammoli vaziyatda muloyimlik bilan yondashadi
e) O‘quvchini o‘z xatosini mustaqil aniqlashga undaydi

explanation: The passage explicitly mentions that olive oil was tossed with the salad. The other statements either introduce false details (grilled, unseasoned) or contradict the praise.
q:
Read the passage:
"The chef prepared a simple salad, tossed it with olive oil, and served it fresh. Everyone praised its crisp taste."
Which statement is true?
opts: A) The salad was cooked on a grill.
B) The dish was served cold and unseasoned.
C) Olive oil was used in the salad.
D) No one liked the salad.
C) Qiziqarli savol yoki qisqa video
q: Dars boshida o‘quvchilarning e’tiborini jalb qilish uchun qaysi usul eng samarali?
explanation: Qiziqarli savol yoki qisqa video o‘quvchilarni darhol diqqatga tortadi, motivatsiyani oshiradi. Uzluksiz ma'lumot, yozma topshiriq yoki uzun tavsiflash o‘zini motivatsiya vositasi sifatida kam samarali.

‘Had been studying’ is past perfect continuous (B), ‘will have finished’ is future perfect (A), and ‘is being taught’ is passive present continuous (C). The combination 1‑B, 2‑A, 3‑C matches these assignments.
q:
Match the verb forms (1‑3) with their grammatical functions (A‑C).
1. had been studying
2. will have finished
3. is being taught
A. Future perfect
B. Past perfect continuous
C. Passive present continuous

Quyidagi ta’lim texnologiyalarini ularning kamchiliklari bilan moslashtiring:
1. Loyiha texnologiyasi
2. Individual ta’lim texnologiyasi
A. Jamoaviy ishlash ko‘nikmalarini rivojlantirmasligi
B. Barcha o‘quvchilar teng qatnashmasligi ehtimoli
explanation: Loyiha texnologiyasi jamoaviy ishlashga e’tibor qaratadi, shuning uchun u jamoaviy ko‘nikmalarni rivojlantirishga imkon beradi; uning kamchiligi – barcha o‘quvchilar teng qatnashmasligi (B). Individual texnologiya esa jamoaviy ko‘nikmalarni rivojlantirmasligi (A).

q: O‘qituvchi avval bir nechta misollarni ko‘rsatib, keyin umumiy qoidani chiqaradi. Bu metod qanday nomlanadi?
explanation: Induksiya metodida o‘qituvchi misollarni taqdim etadi, so‘ng umumiy qoidani chiqaradi. Deduksiya esa avval umumiy qoidani berib, keyin misollar orqali tasdiqlashni o‘z ichiga oladi.

q: O'qituvchi dars boshida o'quvchilarga aeroportda yo'nalish so'rash sahnasini ijro etib, har biriga 'check‑in' roli berdi. Bu metod qaysi guruhga kiradi?
explanation: O'quvchilarning haqiqiy muloqotda faol ishtirok etishi – kommunikativ metodning asosiy xususiyati. Frontal metodda o'qituvchi asosiy nutqchi bo'ladi, tushuntirish metodida ma'lum kontent beriladi, mustaqil o'qish esa yakka ishga yo'naltirilgan.

q:
Ingliz tili darsining to'g'ri ketma‑ketligini tanlang:
1. Yangi leksika taqdim etish
2. Tashkiliy qism va motivatsiya
3. Joriy nazorat (quiz)
4. Mustahkamlash mashg'uloti
explanation: Dars avvalo tashkiliy qism va motivatsiya bilan boshlanadi, keyin yangi leksika kiritiladi, joriy nazorat orqali tushunish darajasi tekshiriladi, oxirida mustahkamlash mashg'uloti o'tkaziladi.
Guruhlarda muammoli vazifalarni birgalikda yechish hamkorlikda o'rganish metodining asosiy xususiyatidir; boshqa variantlar guruh ishiga mos kelmaydi.
q: O'qituvchi sinfni 4-5 kishilik guruhlarga bo'lib, har guruhga "environmental problem" mavzusida muammoli vazifa beradi va natijalarini sinf bilan muhokama qiladi. Bu metod nima?

Formativ baholashga oid to'g'ri mulohazalarni tanlang.
a) O'quvchilarning joriy o'zlashtirishini kuzatadi
b) Faqat dars oxirida ball beradi
d) Qaytma aloqa orqali o'quvni yo'naltiradi
e) Yakuniy imtihon sifatida ishlatiladi
explanation: Formativ baholash dars davomida o'quvchilarning o'zlashtirishini kuzatadi (a) va qaytma aloqa (d) beradi. Ball berish (b) va yakuniy imtihon (e) esa summativ baholashga tegishli.

q: During a discussion about climate change, a student says, "My favorite color is blue." Which response best maintains relevance?
explanation: Redirecting the conversation back to the subject (the ocean's rise) restores relevance. Option A points out irrelevance but does not steer the discussion, while B and D remain off‑topic.
opts: A) Let's talk about the color palette of the presentation.
B) Can you explain why you think the ocean is rising?
D) That's interesting, but how does it relate to the topic?

q: O'qituvchi yangi mavzuni boshlashda qishloqdagi qushlarning ko'chishi haqida qisqa hikoya aytib, o'quvchilarning qiziqishini uyg'otdi. Bu metod nima?
explanation: Mavzuni hayotiy, tasviriy hikoya orqali kiritish – hikoya metodining asosiy xususiyatidir. Induktiv metod misollardan umumiy qoidaga chiqadi, demonstratsiya amaliy ko'rsatma, qayta aloqa esa baholash jarayonidir.

q: Choose the sentence that correctly uses "a" to introduce an example.
opts: A) He is a engineer who specializes in robotics.
B) She bought a apple at the market.
C) They visited a France during their vacation.
D) A dolphin is a mammal that lives in the sea.
explanation: "A" is correctly used before a singular count noun to present an example: "A dolphin is a mammal...". Option A needs "an" before a vowel sound, B requires "an" before "engineer", and D should use the proper name without an article.
Diagnostik boshlang'ich darajani aniqlaydi (1‑B), formativ dars davomida kuzatadi va qayta aloqa beradi (2‑C), summativ yakuniy ball qo'yadi (3‑A).
q:
Baholash turlarini ularning maqsadi bilan moslashtiring:
1. Diagnostik
2. Formativ
3. Summativ
A. Dars oxirida yakuniy ball qo'yish
B. Boshlang'ich bilim darajasini aniqlash
C. Dars davomida o'zlashtirishni kuzatish va qayta aloqa berish

Quyidagi mulohazalar analogiya metodiga tegishli:
a) Qalampirni "yashil daryo" deb tasvirlash
b) Grammatik qoidani real hayotdagi vazifaga qarshi solishtirish
d) O'qituvchi o'quvchilarga "if‑clause" ni suv nasosi bilan taqqoslaydi
e) Yangi leksikani tasodifiy ravishda yodlash
explanation: Analogiya – yangi tushunchani tanish holat bilan solishtirish. Grammatik qoidani haqiqiy vazifaga solishtirish (b) va if‑clause ni suv nasosi bilan taqqoslash (d) analogiyaga mos keladi. Qalampirni tasvirlash (a) metafora, e) – yodlash metodiga tegishli.
The sheriff shouts (1‑A), Robin Hood jumps onto the horse (2‑B), and the green‑clad man throws his hat (3‑C). The other matchings mix up the actions.
q:
Read the passage: "The sheriff shouted, 'Get him!' as Robin Hood leapt over the wall onto a waiting horse. The green‑clad man tossed his hat aside, his red hair flashing in the sunrise." Match the characters to their actions.
1. Sheriff
2. Robin Hood
3. Green‑clad man
A. Shouts commands
B. Jumps onto a horse
C. Throws his hat away

opts: A) A type of space equipment
B) An increase in heart rate
q: Passage: "The astronaut’s vitals were stable, but the mission control noted a slight tremor in his speech, a symptom of microgravity‑induced vertigo." In this context, "vertigo" most likely means:
explanation: The passage links "vertigo" with a tremor in speech caused by microgravity, indicating a physical sensation of dizziness. The other options do not fit the context.

opts: A) The book that you lent me was fascinating.
B) The car, which is red, belongs to my cousin.
C) Mrs. Patel, whose garden is beautiful, won the award.
D) My brother, who lives in London, is visiting tomorrow.
q: Select the sentence that contains a defining (restrictive) relative clause.
explanation: Defining relative clauses identify the noun without commas. 'That you lent me' specifies which book, making it a defining clause. The other clauses are non‑defining and are set off by commas.

q: Dars boshida o'qituvchi "Bugun ingliz tilida sayohat mavzusini muhokama qilamiz" dedi. Bu qadam darsning qaysi bosqichiga kiradi?
explanation: Darsni boshlashda mavzu haqida ma'lumot berish, o'quvchini qiziqtirish – bu darsning tashkiliy va motivatsion bosqichi.

q: O'qituvchi bir necha oddiy gaplarni ko'rsatib, o'quvchilardan "bu gaplarda qanday grammatik tuzilma mavjud?" deb so'radi. Bu metod qaysi?
explanation: Misolardan umumiy qoidaga chiqish inductiv metodning asosiy jarayonidir. Deduktiv metodda avval umumiy qoidani berib, keyin misollar ko'rsatiladi.

q:
Read the passage:
"After the marathon, Lily felt exhausted but proud of finishing the race. She promised herself to train harder for the next event."
What is most likely to happen next?
explanation: Lily's promise to train harder indicates she will begin a new training regimen. The other options contradict her expressed intention.
opts: A) Lily will forget the marathon entirely.
B) Lily will start a new training program.
C) Lily will quit running forever.
D) Lily will avoid any future races.

q:
Read the passage:
"The Arctic sea ice has shrunk by 13% over the past decade, according to satellite measurements. Many scientists believe this trend will continue unless greenhouse‑gas emissions are sharply reduced. In my view, the world must act now to avoid irreversible damage." Which sentence expresses an opinion rather than a fact?
opts: A) Many scientists believe this trend will continue unless emissions are reduced.
B) Satellite measurements show the reduction in ice.
C) In my view, the world must act now to avoid irreversible damage.
D) The Arctic sea ice has shrunk by 13% over the past decade.
explanation: The first three sentences report measurable data or widely accepted scientific expectations, while the last sentence contains a personal stance introduced by "In my view," indicating an opinion.

B. The train departure was after the museum opened.
C. The coffee was shared after meeting at the station.
D. The museum opened before the train left.
explanation: Event 1 (train at 6 am) occurs before the museum opens at 9 am, so 1‑A is correct. Event 2 (meeting at station) precedes the coffee, matching 2‑B. Event 3 (coffee) aligns with 3‑C. Event 4 (museum opening) aligns with 4‑D. Option C presents the correct set of pairings.

Match each active voice sentence (1-4) with its correct passive transformation (A-D):
1. The chef prepares the meal.
2. The committee will approve the proposal.
3. They have delivered the packages.
4. The manager is reviewing the report.
A. The meal is prepared by the chef.
B. The proposal will be approved by the committee.
C. The packages have been delivered.
D. The report is being reviewed by the manager.
explanation: Active to passive: 1 is Simple Present (is prepared, A); 2 is Future Simple (will be approved, B); 3 is Present Perfect (have been delivered, C); 4 is Present Continuous (is being reviewed, D). Correct: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C, 4-D.

opts: A) A sudden drought after the storm.
B) A locust infestation in the fields.
C) Heavy rainfall that followed the storm.
D) The flooding of the fields due to the river overflow.
q:
Read the passage:
"After the storm knocked down several trees, the river overflowed its banks, flooding the nearby fields. Consequently, the farmer lost his entire harvest."
What caused the farmer's loss?
explanation: The passage links the river overflow and subsequent flooding directly to the loss of the harvest. The other options introduce unrelated events.

q:
Select the statements that correctly describe mitigation strategies.
a) Reforestation absorbs CO₂ from the atmosphere.
b) Geo‑engineering eliminates greenhouse gases instantly.
d) Improving energy efficiency reduces overall emissions.
e) Carbon taxes have no impact on consumer behavior.
explanation: Reforestation (a) and energy efficiency (d) are recognized mitigation actions. Geo‑engineering (b) is speculative and not instant, while carbon taxes (e) do affect behavior, so those options are incorrect.
Fresco is painting on wet plaster (1‑C). Impasto involves thick paint for texture (2‑A). Lithography uses a stone surface (3‑B). The other options mix the definitions incorrectly.
q:
Match each term with its correct definition:
1. Fresco
2. Impasto
3. Lithography
A. Technique of applying thick paint to create texture
B. Printing method using a stone surface
C. Painting on wet plaster walls

explanation: Peer review involves expert evaluation (b) and typically requires a clear methodology (d). Conclusions are not guaranteed (a), and revisions are common (e), making those options incorrect.
q:
Identify the statements that accurately describe a peer‑reviewed scientific article.
a) The authors' conclusions are guaranteed to be correct.
b) The manuscript undergoes evaluation by independent experts.
d) The article includes a detailed methodology section.
e) The paper is published without any revision.

Match each sentence fragment with its logical function (A‑D):
1. Because the soil was fertile, the crops thrived.
2. The crops thrived.
3. The farmer watered the fields daily.
4. Consequently, the harvest was abundant.
explanation: Sentence 1 gives the cause, 2 states the result, 3 explains the action leading to the cause, and 4 draws the final conclusion. Option A reflects this correct mapping.

q:
Read the passage:
"Study A found that urban green spaces lower average summer temperatures by 2°C. Study B reported that exposure to natural scenery reduces stress hormone cortisol by 20%. Study C showed that communities with community gardens have 10% higher voter turnout."
Match each study with its most direct societal implication.
1. Reduced heat stress in cities
2. Improved mental health
3. Greater civic engagement
A. Study A
B. Study B
C. Study C
explanation: Study A relates to lower temperatures (1), Study B to reduced cortisol (2), and Study C to higher voter turnout (3). The matching 1‑A, 2‑B, 3‑C correctly aligns each study with its implication.
The author cautions against hype and urges caution, reflecting a skeptical tone. The passage does not express enthusiasm, indifference, or hostility.
q:
Passage: "Despite the hype surrounding the new diet, the evidence remains thin. Consumers should therefore approach the claims with caution rather than enthusiasm."
What is the author's tone?

explanation: The passage describes the sequence: feeling cold (1), wrapping scarf (2), calling taxi (3), entering car (4). Option A correctly lists 2‑3‑1‑4, which matches the narrative flow.
q:
Read the passage:
"After the fireworks ended, Maya felt a sudden chill. She wrapped her scarf tightly, then called a taxi. The driver arrived, and she entered the car, relieved to be warm again."
Place the actions in the correct chronological order.

explanation: The passage shows Alex smiling and whispering about a positive future, indicating hope (a) and determination (d). There is no indication of anger or doubt.
q:
Read the passage:
"After hearing the news about the scholarship, Alex smiled, clenched his fists, and whispered, ‘Now I can finally study abroad.’"
Identify the statements that correctly describe Alex’s feelings.
a) He feels hopeful.
b) He is angry about the news.
d) He is determined to succeed.
e) He doubts his chances.
In the sentence, "The artist who painted the mural is famous," the clause "who painted the mural" is:
explanation: The clause restricts which artist is being talked about, making it a defining relative clause. Non‑defining clauses are set off by commas, which are absent here.

q: Read the passage: "The storm damaged the roof; ___, the family had to stay in a shelter for three weeks." Which word best shows the cause‑effect relationship?
explanation: The word "therefore" signals that the family’s need to stay in a shelter is the result of the roof damage. "However" and "although" introduce contrast, while "meanwhile" indicates simultaneous actions. The correct choice links cause and effect.

q: Read the paragraph: "Maria bought a new laptop. It was very fast and lightweight." What does the pronoun "It" refer to?
explanation: The pronoun "It" replaces the noun "laptop" mentioned in the previous sentence. "The purchase" and "the price" are abstract nouns, and "the store" is not introduced. Hence the correct reference is the laptop.

q: O'qituvchi sinfda bir necha o'quvchini birgalikda muhokama qilishga undadi, lekin har bir talaba o'z fikrini erkin ifoda eta olmaydi. Qaysi pedagogik ko'nikma yetishmayapti?
explanation: Talabalar erkin fikr bildirishda muammo bo'lsa, bu kommunikativ ko'nikmaning yetishmasligini ko'rsatadi. Analitik, texnik yoki yozma ko'nikmalar bu vaziyatda asosiy rol o'ynamaydi.
The statement suggests a desire for pizza without directly asking; the implicature is a polite hint that the student would like to order pizza. It does not indicate dislike or a refusal.
opts: A) The student wants to order pizza
C) The student is stating a fact only
D) The student will not eat pizza
q: In a cafeteria, a student says, "I haven't had pizza all week," while looking at the menu. What is the most likely implicature?

explanation: The logical progression starts with the emergence of spring (2), followed by the sun rising (4), then the garden blooming (1), and finally children playing (3). The other orders break the temporal sequence.
q:
Arrange the sentences of the short paragraph in a coherent order:
1. The garden was full of blooming roses.
2. After a long winter, the first signs of spring appeared.
3. Children came out to play and enjoy the sunshine.
4. The sun rose, warming the earth.

explanation: "However" introduces a contrast between the two statements. "Moreover" adds information, "therefore" shows cause‑effect, and "similarly" indicates similarity, none of which fit the contrast needed.
q: Choose the best connector to complete the sentence: "She loves mountain climbing; ___, she fears heights."

explanation: Both using synonyms (b) and maintaining consistent tense (e) help bind sentences together. Repetition (a) can be excessive, and unrelated anecdotes (d) break cohesion. Therefore the correct pair is b and e.
q:
Identify the statements that correctly illustrate methods of achieving textual cohesion.
a) Repeating key words throughout the text.
b) Using synonyms to avoid repetition.
d) Inserting unrelated anecdotes.
e) Employing consistent tense throughout the passage.

explanation: An academic paragraph begins with an introduction (2), continues with development (1), and ends with a conclusion (3). The other sequences disrupt this logical flow.
q:
Place the paragraph components in the correct academic order:
1. Development with supporting evidence
2. Introduction stating the thesis
3. Conclusion summarizing findings

explanation: In the future passive, the auxiliary 'will be' is used, followed by the past participle 'prepared' and the agent introduced by 'by'. Options B uses present tense, C misplaces the agent, and D lacks the required auxiliary.
opts: A) The meal is prepared by the chef tonight.
B) The chef will be prepared the meal tonight.
C) The meal will be prepared by the chef tonight.
D) The meal will prepare by the chef tonight.
q: Choose the correctly transformed passive version of: "The chef will prepare the meal tonight."

explanation: The auxiliary verb 'does' is added and the main verb returns to base form 'like'. Option A keeps the -s ending, C is not a question format, and D changes the tense incorrectly.
opts: A) Does she likes reading novels?
B) Does she like reading novels?
C) She does like reading novels?
D) Did she like reading novels?
q: Which option correctly turns the statement "She likes reading novels" into a yes‑no question?

explanation: "On the contrary" directly signals a contrast between the simplicity of the plan and the difficulty of execution. "In fact" adds information, "as a result" shows cause‑effect, and "for example" introduces an illustration.
q: Select the best discourse marker to show contrast in the sentence: "The plan was simple; ___, the execution proved difficult."

explanation: The singular noun "committee" is replaced by the singular pronoun "it". "They" implies plural, while "we" and "he" do not match the antecedent.
q: Read the sentence: "The committee approved the proposal, and ___ will implement it next month." Which word correctly substitutes the subject?

Select the statements that correctly describe defining (restrictive) relative clauses.
a) They are set off by commas.
b) They provide essential information.
d) They often use "who" or "that".
e) They can be removed without changing the core meaning.
explanation: Defining relative clauses give essential information (b) and usually use "who" or "that" (d). They are not set off by commas (a) and cannot be removed without affecting the sentence meaning (e).
Dialogni kontekstda tahlil qilish, ma’noni aniqlash va grammatik tuzilmani belgilash – bu kontekstual tahlil yondashuvi bo‘lib, o‘quvchilarga matnni chuqur tushunishga yordam beradi.
q: O‘qituvchi dars boshiida qisqa dialogni namoyish qiladi va o‘quvchilardan asosiy ma’noni aniqlashni, keyin esa dialogdagi grammatik tuzilmani belgilashni so‘raydi. Bu qaysi pedagogik yondashuvga misol?
O'qituvchi darsda interaktiv taqdimot va onlayn topshiriqlar orqali talabalarga yangi grammatik tuzilmani o'rgatadi. Bu harakat qaysi kasbiy standartga mos keladi?
explanation: Interaktiv taqdimot va onlayn topshiriqlarni darsga qo‘shish axborot‑kommunikatsiya texnologiyalarini (AKT) integratsiyalashga to‘g‘ri keladi. Maqsadni aniqlash, ehtiyojlarni baholash yoki yakuniy ball qo‘yish bu kontekstda alohida vazifalardir.

q: O'qituvchi dars boshlanishida 10 savollik test o'tkazib, o'quvchilarning avvalgi ingliz tili darajasini aniqladi. Bu qaysi baholash turi?
explanation: Test orqali o'quvchilarning boshlang'ich bilimlarini aniqlash diagnostik baholashga kiradi. Formativ baholash davomiy jarayonda, summativ yakuniy natijada, kurs baholash esa butun kurs bo'yi qo'llanadi.

The text presents factual information about a new technology without urging purchase or expressing criticism. It aims to increase awareness of the development, which matches option B. Options A and C add persuasion and criticism not present in the passage, while D shifts focus to historical context.
opts: A) To criticize the reliance on traditional energy sources
B) To persuade readers to buy the new solar panel
C) To inform readers about a recent scientific development
D) To describe the history of solar technology
q:
Read the passage:
"Scientists at the GreenTech Institute have developed a new solar panel that can generate electricity even on cloudy days. The panel uses a special coating that captures diffuse sunlight and converts it into usable power, reducing the need for backup generators. This breakthrough could lower energy costs for remote communities.
What is the primary purpose of this passage?"

explanation: The present perfect requires "has" + past participle "written". "Has wrote" is a simple past error, "had written" is past perfect, and "have written" mismatches the third‑person singular subject.
q:
Complete the sentence with the correct past participle.
She ___ (to write) three letters before the meeting started.

Read the passage:
"The new smartphone model has a battery life of up to 20 hours, which is the longest among all devices released this year. It is clearly the best phone on the market."
Which sentence expresses an opinion?
opts: A) It is clearly the best phone on the market.
B) All devices released this year have shorter batteries.
C) It is the longest among all devices released this year.
D) The new smartphone model has a battery life of up to 20 hours.
explanation: Sentence C contains the evaluative phrase "clearly the best phone," which reflects a personal judgment, while the other statements are factual claims about battery capacity.

q: O'qituvchi dars davomida kichik topshiriqlar berib, natija bilan darhol qayta aloqa beradi, ball qo'ymaydi. Bu baholash turi?
explanation: Kichik topshiriqlar va darhol qayta aloqa formativ baholashga xos; summativ baholash odatda ball qo'yishni talab qiladi, diagnostik boshlang'ich bosqichda amalga oshiriladi.

q: O'qituvchi talabalarni internetdan mustaqil ma'lumot topishga, topilgan materialni sinfda taqdim etishga undaydi. Bu qaysi metod?
explanation: O'quv-tadqiqot metodida o'quvchilar mustaqil manbalarni izlab, tahlil qilib, natijani sinfda taqdim etadilar. Frontal ma'ruza o'qituvchiga markaziy rol beradi, qoidalar asosida o'rgatish esa aniq qoidalarni qo'llashni talab qiladi, audio‑visual taqdimot esa multimedia vositalariga e'tibor qaratadi.

First select a subordinating conjunction (1), then craft the main clause (2). Place the subordinate clause after the conjunction (3) and finish with correct punctuation (4). The other orders break this logical sequence.
q:
Arrange the steps to create a correct complex sentence with a subordinate clause.
1. Choose a subordinating conjunction.
2. Write the main clause.
3. Insert the subordinate clause after the conjunction.
4. Add appropriate punctuation.

explanation: Kichik guruhlarda amaliy topshiriq berib, natijalarni baholash hamkorlikda o'rganishning asosiy xususiyatidir. Frontal so'rov butun sinfga qaratiladi, tushuntirish o'qituvchi markazli, mustaqil o'qish yakka ishlashni talab qiladi.
q: O'qituvchi sinfni kichik guruhlarga bo'lib, har bir guruhga "travel brochure" tayyorlash topshirig'ini berdi va natijalarni darhol baholadi. Bu metod qanday nomlanadi?

opts: A) To finish strong, he rested briefly.
B) He then decided to sprint another mile.
C) After the marathon, the runner felt exhausted.
D) He then decided to sprint another mile to finish strong.
explanation: A exhausted runner would not logically choose to sprint further; this choice contradicts the preceding statement, making the sentence incoherent.
q: Read the passage: "After the marathon, the runner felt exhausted. He then decided to sprint another mile to finish strong." Which sentence creates incoherence?
Read the sentence: "During the interview, the candidate was asked to _____ his previous experience in project management." Which word best completes the sentence?
explanation: Elaborate means to give more detail, which is appropriate when describing previous experience. Eliminate means to remove, evade means to avoid, and exaggerate means to overstate, none fit the context.

q: Choose the word that does NOT collocate naturally with "make": "make a decision, make a mistake, make a noise, make a promise".
explanation: "Make a noise" is unnatural; the usual collocation is "make a sound". The other three combinations are common and idiomatic.

‘True or false information’ deals with factual verification (1‑A). ‘Genres of painting’ refers to artistic styles (2‑B). ‘Wonders of the world’ describes notable landmarks (3‑C). The other matchings mix categories incorrectly.
q:
Match each genre of painting mentioned with its defining characteristic:
1. True or false information
2. Genres of painting
3. Wonders of the world
A. Requires verification of factual accuracy
B. Refers to artistic styles and movements
C. Highlights famous natural or man‑made landmarks

explanation: Flabbergasted conveys strong surprise, matching "astonished". Amused implies mild pleasure, dismayed suggests disappointment, and indifferent means no feeling.
q: Select the best synonym for "astonished" in the sentence: "She was absolutely astonished by the surprise party."
Which of the following is the correct noun formed from the adjective "creative" using a common suffix?
explanation: The suffix -ity forms the noun "creativity" from "creative". The other options either add non‑standard suffixes or change meaning incorrectly.

opts: C) Dars jarayonida AKT integratsiyasini rejalashtirish
D) Baholash natijalarini yozma shaklda berish
q: O'qituvchi dars davomida interaktiv taqdimot, onlayn test va video materiallardan foydalandi. Bu qaysi pedagogik standartga mos keladi?
explanation: AKT integratsiyasi darsda texnologik vositalarni qo'llashni talab qiladi; boshqa variantlar bu vazifaga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
"Advice" is an uncountable noun, so the correct phrase is "some advice" or "a piece of advice". The other parts are grammatically correct.
q: Read the sentence: "She gave me an advice about studying harder." Which part contains the lexical error?
In the sentence "He will ___ the meeting tomorrow," which verb best fits?
explanation: "Attend" means to be present at an event, which is appropriate for a meeting. "Visit" implies a place, "enter" focuses on the act of going inside, and "approach" refers to moving toward, not participating.

q: Read the passage: "The detective examined the scene, noting the myriad of clues that seemed to corroborate the suspect's alibi." What does "corroborate" most likely mean here?
explanation: In this context, "corroborate" means to provide support or confirmation for the suspect's alibi. It does not mean to contradict, ignore, or question.

q: O'qituvchi sinfni 4 kishilik guruhlarga bo'lib, har biriga "turist guide" roli berib, aeroport yo'nalishini tavsiya qilish vazifasini topshirdi. Bu metod qaysi dars bosqichiga kiradi?
explanation: Rol o'ynash orqali o'quvchilar amaliy mashq bajaradi, bu darsning amaliyot (mashq) bosqichiga to'g'ri keladi. Yangi materialni taqdim etishda ma'lumot beriladi, motivatsiya bosqichida talaba qiziqtiriladi, baholash oxirgi bosqichda amalga oshiriladi.

q:
Select the statements that correctly describe the word "inevitable".
a) It expresses certainty about a future event.
b) It can be used to describe a temporary situation.
d) It often collocates with "outcome".
e) It indicates a personal opinion rather than a fact.
explanation: "Inevitable" conveys certainty about something that must happen (a) and commonly appears with "outcome" (d). It does not describe temporary situations, nor does it express personal opinion.

q:
Place the following stages of learning a new vocabulary item in the correct chronological order:
1. Use the word in a sentence independently.
2. Encounter the word in a reading passage.
3. Study the definition and pronunciation.
4. Review the word through spaced repetition.
explanation: First the learner encounters the word (2), then studies its meaning and sound (3), uses it independently (1), and finally reinforces it through spaced repetition (4).

Formativ baholash dars ichida o'quvchilarning o'zlashtirishini kuzatadi va darhol qayta aloqa beradi, ball qo'yilmaydi. Summativ yakuniy natija uchun ball kerak bo'ladi, diagnostik boshlang'ich darajani aniqlashga qaratilgan.
q: O'qituvchi dars davomida qisqa test o'tkazib, o'quvchilarning yutuqlarini kuzatadi, lekin ball qo'ymaydi. Bu baholash turi qaysi?
Choose the adjective that naturally collocates with "effort" in the phrase "_____ effort".
explanation: "Hard effort" (more commonly "hard work") is the natural collocation. "Hardly" means barely, "hardness" is a noun, and "hardening" is a verb form, none fit the pattern.

q: In a classroom, a teacher says to a student, "Could you hand me the worksheet, please?" Which speech act does this utterance represent?
explanation: The teacher is asking the student to do something, which is a request. It is not a simple statement, promise, or a genuine question seeking information.

q:
Read the dialogue:
A: "Do you like my new haircut?"
B: "It's certainly different."
Which statements correctly describe the implicature of B's response?
a) B approves the haircut.
b) B dislikes the haircut.
d) B is being neutral.
e) B is being sarcastic.
explanation: The response "It's certainly different" often implies a negative judgment (b) and can carry sarcasm (e). It does not convey approval or neutrality.
The use of "Please" and the directive in a professional context demonstrates formal politeness appropriate for a professor-student relationship.
q: A university professor emails a student: "Please submit your assignment by Friday." Which politeness level does this utterance reflect?

Match the speech‑act type with the most likely communicative goal.
1. Assertive
2. Directive
3. Commissive
4. Expressive
explanation: Assertives convey information or state facts, directives aim to get the listener to act, commissives commit the speaker to future action, and expressives convey emotions or attitudes. The other options mix the categories incorrectly.

q: O‘qituvchi dars boshlanishida "Bugun ingliz tilida tabiat haqida gaplashamiz" deb aytadi. Bu qadam qaysi pedagogik bosqichga kiradi?
explanation: Darsning boshlanishida aniq maqsadni aytish – dars maqsadini belgilash bosqichiga tegishli. Material tanlash, baholash usuli aniqlash yoki uyga vazifa berish keyingi bosqichlarda amalga oshiriladi.

q:
Arrange the speech acts in the correct order for a typical negotiation scenario:
1. Offer
2. Counter‑offer
3. Acceptance
4. Opening statement
explanation: Negotiations typically begin with an opening statement, followed by an initial offer, a counter‑offer, and finally an acceptance.
Using harsh, insulting language in a formal setting violates norms of politeness and professionalism, making it highly inappropriate.
q: In a formal business meeting, a participant says, "That idea is totally stupid!" How appropriate is this utterance?

explanation: Dars motivatsiya bilan boshlanadi, so'ng yangi tuzilma tushuntiriladi, kommunikativ mashqlar bajariladi, oxirida uyga vazifa va baholash keladi. Shuning uchun 3,1,4,2 tartibi to'g'ri.
q:
Zamonaviy ingliz tili darsining bosqichlarini to'g'ri ketma-ketlikda joylashtiring:

2. Uyga vazifa berish va baholash

2. "serene"
3. "chaotic"

B. A quiet library room
C. A traffic jam during rush hour
explanation: "Bustling" fits a lively market, "serene" suits a quiet library, and "chaotic" describes a traffic jam. The other pairings mismatch the connotations.
Formativ baholash joriy o'zlashtirishni kuzatadi (a) va qaytma aloqa orqali yo'naltiradi (d). Yakuniy ball qo'yish (b) va yakuniy baholash (e) summativ baholashga tegishli.

q: O'qituvchi avval bir necha aniq misollar ("She reads a book", "They watch a movie") keltirib, so'ng umumiy qoidani: "Present Simple zamonida har bir sub'ektga mos fe'l shakli qo'llanadi" deb chiqaradi. Bu qaysi metod?

C) O'zlashtirishni baholash va qayta aloqani taqdim etish
D) Xavfsiz va qo'llab-quvvatlovchi ta'lim muhitini yaratish va ta'minlash
q: O'qituvchi dars boshida ota-onalar bilan hamkorlik rejasini tuzib, o'quvchilarning yangi leksikani o'zlashtirishini kuzatadi. Bu qaysi pedagogik vazifaga kiradi?
explanation: Ota-onalar bilan hamkorlik rejasini tuzish va dars faoliyatini belgilash o'quv jarayonini rejalashtirishga kiradi. Xavfsiz muhit yaratish, baholash yoki o'z-o'zini rivojlantirish alohida vazifalardir.
Darsni boshlashda o'quvchilarni qiziqtirish, maqsadni e'lon qilish va tashkiliy ishlarni bajarish motivatsiya va tashkiliy bosqichga kiradi. Bilim berish keyingi qadamda amalga oshiriladi.
q: O'qituvchi dars boshida "Bugun ingliz tilida qisqa film ko'rib, muhim iboralarni ajratamiz" deb e'lon qildi. Bu qadam qaysi dars bosqichiga kiradi?

explanation: Dars boshlanishida o'quvchilarning oldingi bilim darajasini aniqlash maqsadi diagnostik baholashga kiradi; bu baholash natijalari dars rejasini tuzishda qo'llaniladi.

b) O'qituvchi dars davomida qayta aloqa beradi

explanation: In this context “elaborate” means to provide a detailed explanation. Option A suggests brevity, C suggests refusal, and D suggests diversion, none of which match the intended meaning.

opts: A) Har bir notanish so'zni ona tiliga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tarjima qilib berish
B) Matndagi kontekstual ishoralar (Context clues) orqali ma'noni taxmin qilishga undash
